_comment: The corporate holiday season board. Built 2026-08-15 for the Nov/Dec 2026 landing page.
_MAINTENANCE: THIS IS THE ONE FILE ON THE SITE THAT GOES STALE. It publishes availability, which is a factual claim about the calendar, and a wrong one costs a double booking or a lost enquiry. Update `status` per date as holds and bookings land, and bump `updated` every time. The page prints `updated` on it so a visitor can see how fresh the board is; that is deliberate and should not be removed.
_STATUS_WARNING: Every date below currently reads `open` because no booking calendar was supplied with the restructure spec. That is an assumption, not a verified fact. True it up against the real calendar BEFORE this page is promoted anywhere.
label: November and December 2026
_dates_note: Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, which is where corporate holiday parties actually sit. Thanksgiving (Nov 26) and Christmas (Dec 24 to 26) are out. New Year's Eve is in and priced at +50% per the extras list.
_status_values: open | held | booked. `held` renders as a soft hold that can still be beaten; `booked` renders struck through, because a season board with nothing gone on it is not evidence of anything.
_leads_note: The three configurations to lead the holiday page with, per the restructure spec. Named by act id so they resolve against acts.json rather than being retyped here.

leads.why: The whole night on one line, at the smallest number on this page. The format most corporate parties actually book.
Drinks and dinner covered without anybody raising their voice over it. The safest booking on the page for a room that has speeches in it.
The dance floor booking. Book this when the party is the point rather than the backdrop.
